summary: Protobuf namespace conflict between vendored external_storage.proto in SDK v1.43.0 and the public version in go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12+ causes init-time panic when both packages are imported. The SDK vendors a copy of the proto file, while the API package added the same file, causing duplicate registration in the global protobuf registry.
userImpact: Any consumer importing both go.temporal.io/sdk v1.43.0 and go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12+ experiences an immediate panic at startup, blocking routine dependency updates and forcing version pinning.
rootCause: go.temporal.io/sdk v1.43.0 vendors external_storage.proto at internal/temporalapi/sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go, while go.temporal.io/api v1.62.12 added the same file at sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go; both register with the global protobuf registry which requires unique file names.
proposedFix: Remove vendored internal/temporalapi/sdk/v1/external_storage.pb.go from the SDK and depend on the public go.temporal.io/api/sdk/v1 package instead.
workaround: Pin go.temporal.io/api to v1.62.11 or earlier
resolutionDetails: Removed vendored internal/temporalapi/ directory and repointed sdkpb imports in internal/extstore/ to go.temporal.io/api/sdk/v1, with go.temporal.io/api bumped to v1.62.12.
keyQuote: proto: file "temporal/api/sdk/v1/external_storage.proto" has a name conflict over temporal.api.sdk.v1.ExternalStorage...
